title: One error envelope: the shared sentences, and the normaliser that turns any error response into one

functions.normalise: normalise({status, headers, body, now?}) -> null | {status, code, sentence, fields, retryAfter, requestId}
functions.formatDuration: formatDuration(s) -> string (the retry clause, no leading space)

contract.summary: Normative text: suites/http/SPEC.md sections 2 and 6. Written BEFORE any implementation (CC-fancy-0031). The envelope's JSON Schema is envelope.schema.json beside this file; each package ships a byte copy pinned by sha256.
contract.referenceNote: Authored from suites/http/SPEC.md in scripts/build-http-cases.py on 2026-11-12, before any implementation existed. tests/http-probe.ts is a reading of the spec that passes every row, and tests/discrimination-http.test.ts pins the mistakes it catches.

notes: Python runs formatBytes, formatDuration and sanitise, which its guard uses to write sentences; every normalise row carries skip.python with the reason.
Two halves on purpose: the servers EMIT one strict shape, and the normaliser ACCEPTS every shape a real server sends, because the UI talks to servers nobody here wrote.
